> **The entry point.** Whoever resumes the project reads this file first and only then opens what they
> need. The aim is that only **the previous step, the current one and the next** need deciphering;
> everything else is reached by shortcut instead of being rebuilt by inference.
>
> This index **points**. It never copies. If a fact is in two places, one of them is wrong and nobody
> knows which.

## The axes

> **The dot in front of the name is deliberate.** It marks a low-level path, read by the harness, not by
> the person who opens the repository to see what the project does. The root keeps the front doors; the
> thinking stays here.

| axis | what it holds |
|---|---|
| [`.orders/`](../.orders/) | the Orders — the contract that dispatches the work, immutable and numbered |
| [`.changelog/`](../.changelog/README.md) | where the work stands, the road ahead, every version and its decisions |
| `.shortcuts/` | this file, and [`.virtual/`](.virtual/README.md) — the agent's first peek: what is ongoing, what is only backlog, and which norm governs which code |

regency's facts and rules are the product itself and live in [`library/`](../../library/): the axes for
sources, decisions, plan and constraints are not opened here, and there is no attic.

## The project's map, in five lines

> Five lines, no more. If it does not fit in five, the rest is a document, not a shortcut, and it goes to
> the axis it belongs to.

1. `library/registry.json` is the core: `scripts/build.py` reads it; the playbooks in `skills/` read `library/` and run `scripts/`.
2. The registry and `library/conventions.md` are the sources of truth; `commands/` and the tables in `CLAUDE.md`, `README.md` and `library/REFERENCE.md` are projections.
3. `commands/`, the packaged archive and the marked tables cannot be: they are generated from the registry and never edited by hand.
4. The incomplete case is a question: a doubt is queued and work goes on; only a blocker stops it (`library/conventions.md` §3).
5. Every change passes `python scripts/build.py --check` and `python scripts/doctor.py`, locally and in `.github/workflows/doctor.yml`.

> The left column is **the question the person has**, not the document's title. Whoever resumes a

| "why did a version move?" | [`.changelog/HISTORY.md`](../.changelog/HISTORY.md) |
